title: Create: Crowbar
description: Make the wrench from Create look like a crowbar from Half-Life!
body:
Use this crowbar to assist you in your engineering endeavors. Though unfortunately it is not as lethal as it looks.

Renames the item. Currently supports only two languages: Russian and English

Also checkout:
